app.name: S3S
connections.description: Manage object storage profiles saved on this device.
connections.name: Connection name
connections.emptyText: Create a local profile to save a provider, region and endpoint.
connections.noMatchText: Try another name or provider filter.
connections.noCloud: AWS S3 and Cloudflare R2 support read-only browsing and downloads. Other providers support local profile setup.
connections.endpointHint: Use an HTTP or HTTPS origin without credentials, paths or query parameters.
objects.description: Choose a connection to explore buckets and objects.
objects.title: Objects
objects.emptyText: Select an AWS S3 or Cloudflare R2 profile to list buckets, browse prefixes and download objects.
tasks.description: View transfer records and their state on this device.
tasks.title: Transfer queue
tasks.emptyText: Download an object to track its progress here, pause it or resume it later.
settings.description: Choose the language of your workspace and manage imported language packs.
settings.languageHint: Applies immediately and preserves transfer state.
settings.importHelp: Import translations from a JSON file. Missing entries use English.
settings.importError: Could not import this pack. Check its size, locale, keys and placeholders.
error.preview: The browser preview cannot access the local database. Open the desktop app to manage profiles and view tasks.
error.bridge: Could not reach the desktop service. Please retry.
error.invalidConnection: Check the profile name, provider and endpoint.
error.invalidTransition: This action is unavailable in the current state.
error.notFound: The requested record was not found.
error.conflict: The record changed. Refresh and try again.
credentials.title: Credentials for {name}
credentials.hint: Credentials are saved in the system keyring for this connection. Saving replaces existing credentials. Check the endpoint below.
objects.unsupported: This provider is not connected yet
objects.bucketHint: If your credentials are scoped to a bucket, open it by name.
error.cloudRequest: The cloud request failed. Check the network, region and endpoint, then retry.
error.cloudAccess: The provider denied access. Check the credentials and the bucket read policy.
error.cloudMissing: The bucket or object could not be found. Refresh the listing.
error.cloudChanged: The remote object changed. Select it again and start a new download.
error.cloudRange: The provider returned an invalid byte range. The download has stopped.
error.cloudCredentials: The credentials are invalid or expired. Update this connection’s credentials.
error.cloudProvider: This operation is unavailable for this provider.
error.credentialsMissing: Set credentials for this connection before continuing.
error.keyringUnavailable: The system keyring is unavailable. Check that it is running and unlocked.
error.invalidCredentials: Enter a valid access key ID and secret access key.
error.connectionChanged: The profile changed. Select the connection again and retry.
error.dialog: Could not open the system file dialog. Retry the operation.
error.downloadBusy: The download is already running. Check its state in Task center.
error.appClosing: The app is shutting down. Retry after restarting it.
error.downloadIdentity: The object or connection identity cannot be confirmed. Start a new download at a different destination.
error.downloadRange: A range response had an unexpected byte count. Writing stopped. Retry the download.
error.downloadFile: Could not read, write or sync the temporary file. Check disk space and file permissions.
error.downloadDestination: The destination is occupied or unavailable. Choose an unused local file name.
error.pagination: The provider returned a repeated page token. Refresh the listing.
credentials.forgetPrompt: Remove the credentials for {name} from the system keyring? Browsing and resuming downloads will require entering them again.
connections.awsHint: Leave blank to use the regional AWS S3 endpoint. The region defaults to us-east-1.
connections.r2Hint: Use the account HTTPS S3 endpoint from your Cloudflare R2 dashboard. The signing region is auto.
error.workspaceInUse: Another S3S process is using this workspace. Close it, then restart the app.
